summary: Property condition assessment of 8330 Power Inn Road (site visit 2026-06-18). The roof is the original 2001 built-up membrane with no documented replacement, showing ponding at the NE corner and membrane blistering with an open seam near suite 105; replacement is recommended within 12-24 months, $85,000-$95,000. Two of the eight rooftop HVAC units (suites 103 and 106) are original 1998 units beyond typical service life, operational at inspection, budgeted for replacement in 3-5 years at $14,000-$18,000 each. Electrical and plumbing were serviceable with no immediate needs. Paving needs a seal coat and restripe within 3-5 years, $6,000-$8,000.

findings.value: Original built-up membrane installed 2001; no documented replacement
findings.detail: Well past the typical 20-year service life for this roof type.

findings.value: Ponding water at the NE corner, approx. 1/2 inch after 48 dry hours
findings.detail: Indicates a drainage deficiency at that corner of the roof.

findings.value: Membrane blistering and an open seam near the suite 105 HVAC curb
findings.detail: Blistering indicates trapped moisture beneath the membrane; the open seam is an active leak risk.

findings.value: 8 packaged rooftop units: 6 units installed 2014-2019 in good order; suites 103 and 106 have original 1998 units beyond typical service life, operational at inspection
findings.detail: Budget replacement of the two 1998 units within 3-5 years, $14,000-$18,000 each.

findings.value: Asphalt paving shows typical wear; no structural failures observed
findings.detail: Recommend seal coat and restripe within 3-5 years, $6,000-$8,000.
